card.name: Small words in Chinese-context passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, the and in, or a bracket after a Chinese name, mostly in text about China or in formal policy-like prose. Also fires on a few nouns like use and development before of.

modes.label: Chinese name in authors
modes.description: Chinese characters or bracket inside a Chinese author name in a citation.

modes.label: Linking words in formal prose
modes.description: The word of, the or in inside formal text on national affairs, development or use.
modes.example: not to interfere in the internal affairs<< of>> other countries.
